text:
lauren: Quick follow-up from yesterday's pinning RFC — I sketched a compact telemetry contract for pin lifecycle so ops can measure grace-window violations and correlate with rollouts. High level idea: keep metadata changes minimal, emit a structured event for analysis.

lauren: rough event shape I'm proposing:
```
{
  pin_event: "leased|released|expired",
  pin_trace_id: "<uuid>",
  pin_id: "<uuid>",
  model: "mymodel@v1.2.3",
  lease_start_ts: "2026-03-20T15:04:05Z",
  lease_end_ts: "2026-03-20T15:09:05Z|null",
  grace_end_ts: "2026-03-20T15:10:05Z|null",
  lease_duration_ms: 300000
}
```

lauren: Questions we need answered: do we add these fields to persistent model_pin metadata (schema change) or keep them as emitted telemetry events only? How do we version the contract so runtime + console + dedicated/private clients remain compatible?

dan: lean towards event-only first. adding shape to persistent metadata risks breaking clients that parse pin records. telemetry lets us iterate and run queries without a hard DB migration.

dan: also retention/cost — emitted events go into TSDB/ES with a TTL we control. persistent fields increase storage across tenants.

mike: +1 for events, but we still need a stable correlation id so you can join events to a specific pin write and to rollout hooks. propose adding a single optional field `pin_trace_id` to metadata (nullable). That keeps metadata changes tiny. Telemetry contains full payload and references trace id.

sophia: `pin_trace_id` sounds reasonable. we should also decide canonical ownership of grace window calculation: server calculates `grace_end_ts` based on lease + grace_seconds, not clients. simplify client behaviour.

lauren: agreed — server-calculated grace_end. for metadata changes I propose: add optional fields to pin metadata: `pin_trace_id` (string), `lease_start_ts` (ts), `lease_end_ts` (ts|null), `lease_grace_seconds` (int). Keep names namespaced: `pin.*` or `redwood.pin.*`?

eva: ops perspective: we need a derived metric: histogram(grace_latency = grace_end_ts - lease_end_ts) and counter(pin_grace_violations{model,region} > threshold). also want sample events exported to ES for traces. make sure telemetry includes `deployment_id` and `region`.

dan: small privacy/security note: for Private on-prem customers we can't ship telemetry externally. `pin_trace_id` must be local-only by default; telemetry export should be opt-in for private deployments. 

mike: implement details: do not block the pin write path on telemetry. Generate `pin_trace_id` synchronously on pin creation if not provided, write minimal metadata, then send `pin.lifecycle` event asynchronously. This keeps p99 writes stable.

lauren: OK so consensus so far: 1) emit `pin.lifecycle` telemetry events with the full shape, 2) add a tiny optional `pin_trace_id` to metadata for correlation, 3) server-calculated `grace_end_ts` derived from `lease_*` + `lease_grace_seconds`, 4) telemetry export must be configurable per deployment (disabled by default for private).

sophia: on schema versioning: add a `pin: { schema_version: "v1" }` top-level label in metadata so future fields can be gated. Avoid overloading the top-level `metadata.version` key.

lauren: migration plan idea: write path will accept old and new shapes. For existing pins, we don't backfill metadata; telemetry for new lease writes will include `pin_trace_id`. We can run an async backfill if customers request.

mike: for console and dashboards: we should expose both event stream and derived metrics. ES mapping: `pin_trace_id` as keyword, `lease_*` as date, `lease_duration_ms` as long.

eva: alerting thresholds: default rule suggestion: warn if >5% pins per model exceed grace window in 15m, critical at 20%. Ops will tune.

dan: compatible api change checklist: SDKs should ignore unknown fields; we'll document `pin_trace_id` as optional. rollout plan: launch telemetry + metadata opt-in for 2 weeks in staging, then enable default for hosted.

lauren: I'll draft the small RFC PR with the event schema, the minimal metadata additions, migration path, and the observability dashboards + suggested alerts. Will include sample PromQL and ES mappings.

schema-bot: Created branch lauren/pin-telemetry-contract and opened PR #4287 for review.

mike: quick nit: use `lease_grace_seconds` (int) rather than storing `grace_end_ts` in metadata. prefer computed ts in events, seconds in metadata for portability.

lauren: noted — events will keep `grace_end_ts` while metadata keeps `lease_grace_seconds`. I'll update the PR.

sophia: approve to ship after PR updates, but add a runtime feature flag so we can disable if we see unexpected perf regressions.

lauren: cool. I'll incorporate feature flag + privacy opt-out for private deployments. PR incoming in ~2h.

mike: :thumbsup:

eva: :eyes: will prepare dashboards for when events land.

lauren: thanks all — will ping once PR is ready for review.
